name: com.fuzzzycore.law/georgian-law
title: Fuzzzy Law: Georgian law
description: Exact text of Georgian laws from matsne.gov.ge and published court decisions, with official links

tools.name: list_codes
tools.description: List the Georgian codes available, with article counts, official links and version dates. ხელმისაწვდომი კოდექსების სია: მუხლების რაოდენობა, ოფიციალური ბმული და ვერსიის თარიღი.

tools.name: search_law
tools.description: Search Georgian law articles by words. Search in Georgian, with the terms the law itself uses; if the results are off the point, search again with the law's own word and ignore also_searched terms that do not fit. Returns matching articles with an exact text snippet, code, article number, official matsne.gov.ge link and version date. found=false means nothing matched: say so, never guess. კანონის მუხლების ძიება სიტყვებით: ზუსტი ამონარიდი, კოდექსი, მუხლის ნომერი, ოფიციალური ბმული და თარიღი.

query.description: What to look for, best in Georgian legal terms, e.g. 'სააპელაციო საჩივრის ვადა'.
query.title: Query

code.description: Optional: limit to one code (id or name).
code.title: Code

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get the full exact text of one article, with its paragraphs, official link, version date and the previous and next article. Use it to check deadlines, amounts and ages before stating them. Pass as_of (a date) for the newest matsne version dated on or before that day; its changes may have taken effect later, so give the version date. ერთი მუხლის სრული ზუსტი ტექსტი, ოფიციალური ბმული და რედაქციის თარიღი; as_of თარიღით მიიღებ იმ დღემდე ბოლო რედაქციას.

code.description: Code id from list_codes (e.g. civil_code, labour_code) or its Georgian name (e.g. შრომის კოდექსი).
code.title: Code

article.description: Article number as printed, e.g. 369, 48 or 166¹ (166-1 also works). A paragraph goes in its own argument. Check that article_number in the reply is the one you asked for.
article.title: Article

as_of.description: Optional date as YYYY-MM-DD: return the newest matsne version dated on or before that day instead of the current one (its changes may have taken effect later).
as_of.title: As Of

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List the articles of a law that were amended, added or removed since a date, by consolidated version on matsne.gov.ge, with a link to each version. Use it to see whether a rule was different when the events happened. კანონის ცვლილებები მითითებული თარიღიდან: რომელი მუხლი შეიცვალა, დაემატა ან ამოიღეს და რომელ რედაქციაში.

code.description: Code id from list_codes (e.g. civil_code, labour_code) or its Georgian name (e.g. შრომის კოდექსი).
code.title: Code

tools.name: browse_code
tools.description: Show a code's structure: its chapters, or the article numbers and titles of one chapter. კოდექსის სტრუქტურა: თავები ან ერთი თავის მუხლების ნომრები და სათაურები.

code.description: Code id from list_codes (e.g. civil_code, labour_code) or its Georgian name (e.g. შრომის კოდექსი).
code.title: Code

chapter.description: Optional chapter to list articles of.
chapter.title: Chapter

tools.name: find_court_practice
tools.description: Find real decisions of Georgian courts on an issue: case number, court, date, exact snippet and link when stored. get_coverage lists the courts held; pass court to search one of them only. Read a decision with get_court_decision before you describe it. With status none_found, say in one line that no published decision was found in the collections held, up to decisions_through, and that this does not mean none exists. სასამართლო პრაქტიკა: რეალური გადაწყვეტილებები, საქმის ნომერი, თარიღი.

query.description: What to look for, best in Georgian legal terms, e.g. 'სააპელაციო საჩივრის ვადა'.
query.title: Query

court.description: Optional: search only the Supreme Court (supreme) or only the Constitutional Court (constitutional).
court.title: Court

tools.name: get_court_decision
tools.description: Read a stored court decision in full, twenty passages per call, by the id from find_court_practice or its printed case number. Read it before you describe what the court decided. The text is as the court published it: the Supreme Court prints parties as initials, the Constitutional Court prints their names. გადაწყვეტილების სრული ტექსტი ნაწილ-ნაწილ, იმ სახით, როგორც სასამართლომ გამოაქვეყნა.

id.description: A decision id from find_court_practice (case:court_practice:ას-398-398-2018) or a printed case number (ას-398-398-2018, or 3/1/1459 for a Constitutional Court judgment).
id.title: Id

from_passage.description: Passage to start from; use next_passage to read on.
from_passage.title: From Passage

tools.name: verify_citation
tools.description: Check a citation: does the article (and paragraph) exist, is it repealed, and what does it actually say. Pass quote to check a quotation word for word; the quote is looked for in the whole article, not only the paragraph named. Includes a word-and-number overlap check, not a legal judgement. ციტატის შემოწმება: არსებობს თუ არა მუხლი, რას ამბობს სინამდვილეში და ზუსტია თუ არა მოყვანილი ციტატა.

code.description: Code id from list_codes (e.g. civil_code, labour_code) or its Georgian name (e.g. შრომის კოდექსი).
code.title: Code

article.description: Article number as printed, e.g. 369, 48 or 166¹ (166-1 also works). A paragraph goes in its own argument. Check that article_number in the reply is the one you asked for.
article.title: Article

claim.description: What your answer says this article provides.
claim.title: Claim

quote.description: Optional: words you quote from the article, to check they are in it word for word. Join left-out parts with …
quote.title: Quote

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What this service holds: the laws with their version dates and how far back their earlier wordings go, the court decisions and their date range, and what is not held. Call it when unsure whether a topic is covered. რა ინახება სერვისში: კანონები და მათი რედაქციების თარიღები, სასამართლო გადაწყვეტილებები და ის, რაც არ ინახება.

tools.name: find_legal_aid
tools.description: Where a person in Georgia can get free legal help: the state Legal Aid Service, the Public Defender and others, with phone, hours and website. Give these when the matter is serious, a deadline is running or the person cannot pay a lawyer. სად მიიღებს ადამიანი უფასო იურიდიულ დახმარებას საქართველოში: ტელეფონი, სამუშაო საათები და ვებგვერდი.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Georgian law articles and court decisions. Returns ids, titles and official links; call fetch with an id for the full text. კანონებისა და გადაწყვეტილებების ძიება.

query.description: What to look for, best in Georgian legal terms, e.g. 'სააპელაციო საჩივრის ვადა'.
query.title: Query

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full text, official link and version details behind a search result id. ძიების შედეგის სრული ტექსტი და ოფიციალური ბმული.

id.description: An id from search, e.g. article:civil_code:138.
id.title: Id
